trigger: U04 verifier report (wave 2): it sent the user's email from the session context in a User-Agent header to api.weather.gov while re-opening a vendor source.
lesson: Verifier/executor subagents told to 're-open a vendor source' may fill an API's contact-info User-Agent with the user's email from session context.
how_to_apply: Put an explicit privacy rule in every guide/brief that sends agents to external APIs: generic User-Agent, no personal data in URLs/headers/payloads; grep run artifacts for the address afterwards.
